[SWS_DM_00097] Abort on failed verification step
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04276
⌈
Whenever one of the verification steps fails, further processing of the request shall be
aborted and a negative response shall be sent back.
⌋
The negative response code to be used will be defined in each step described in the
following sections.
7.3.2.5.1 UDS request format checks
